description: ONE SNAPSHOT OF BOTH MARKETS, no arguments. Top instruments across crypto AND US stocks together, ranked by Martingale Score (0-5), with their Startingale readings. Use this to open a conversation or answer "how do things look right now". For a single asset class use crypto_overview or stock_overview; to choose the count or filter, use search_instruments. Answers in formatted text. Costs 10 units of the monthly quota: the most expensive call, since it reads both catalogues; the single-class overviews cost half, so do not call this in a loop.
name: market_overview
